description: Unit test class for the ConnectionLoggerRegistry, testing various behaviors such as logger addition, reset, mute/unmute, log aggregation, and capacity limits within the messaging connectivity module.

classes.name: ConnectionLoggerRegistryTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the behavior of ConnectionLoggerRegistry, including logger management and log aggregation.

methods.name: addsLoggerToRegistryOnRetrieve
methods.description: Tests that retrieving a logger for a connection returns the same instance and adds it to the registry.

methods.name: clearsLoggersOnReset
methods.description: Tests that resetting a connection clears its logs.

methods.name: leavesMutedLoggersMutedOnReset
methods.description: Ensures that after reset, muted loggers remain muted.

methods.name: leavesActivatedLoggersActivatedOnReset
methods.description: Ensures that after reset, activated loggers remain active.

methods.name: clearsLoggersOnMute
methods.description: Tests that muting and then unmuting a connection clears its logs.

methods.name: isActiveForConnection
methods.description: Checks if a connection's logging activity status is correct after initialization and state changes.

methods.name: isLoggingExpiredIsTrueByDefault
methods.description: Verifies that logging is considered expired by default after initialization.

methods.name: isLoggingExpiredIsFalseForCurrentTimestamp
methods.description: Checks that logging is not expired at the current time when unmuted.

methods.name: isLoggingExpiredIsTrueForFutureTimestamp
methods.description: Ensures logging is expired for timestamps after the mute duration.

methods.name: isLoggingExpiredIsTrueAfterMutingConnections
methods.description: Confirms that muting a connection marks its logs as expired.

methods.name: aggregatesLogs
methods.description: Tests log aggregation for a connection including order and content, with multiple log entries.

methods.name: aggregatesLogsRespectsMaximumLogSizeLimit
methods.description: Ensures that log aggregation respects the configured maximum log size.

methods.name: addLogEntriesUntilMaxSizeIsExceeded
methods.description: Helper that adds logs until the maximum size condition is met to test size limits.

methods.name: getCurrentLogsSize
methods.description: Calculates total size of logs in bytes.

methods.name: aggregatesNoLogsForMutedLoggers
methods.description: Verifies that muted loggers produce no aggregated logs.

methods.name: enableConnectionLogsUnmutesTheLoggersAndStartsTimer
methods.description: Tests that unmuting enables logging and updates timer.

methods.name: disableConnectionLogsMutesTheLoggersAndStopsTimer
methods.description: Verifies that muting disables logging and resets timers.

methods.name: testEqualsAndHashcode
methods.description: Checks that the class's equals and hashcode methods conform to contract.

methods.name: connectionId
methods.description: Helper to generate random connection IDs for testing.

methods.name: connection
methods.description: Helper to create mock Connection objects with given IDs.

methods.name: testImmutabilityOfCollectionLogs
methods.description: Tests that the collection of logs is immutable.

methods.name: testEqualsAndHashcodeOfCollectionLogs
methods.description: Verifies equality and hashcode behavior for ConnectionLogs class.
